node.statement: Structure and asymptotics: UCP implies Phi(I)=I and Phi(X^*)=Phi(X)^*. Therefore F(I)=0, B(I)=I, A0(I)=I and P(I)=I; the real-coefficient series and composition show P(X^*)=P(X)^*. A bounded idempotent has Im(P)=Ker(I-P), so its image is closed, complete in the inherited norm, self-adjoint, contains I, and its restricted matrix norms form the inherited complete operator-space structure. The same formulas commute with every matrix amplification. Finally, for 0<=eta<=1/8 the mean-value theorem gives r<=6 sqrt(2) eta, so r=O(eta) with a universal dimension-free constant.
